text: Gate 5 landed via the vision-alignment epic's Phase 2: benchmarks/run-query-first-scale.R + benchmark-results/query-first-scale-gate.rds + tests/testthat/test-query-first-scale.R. Selected edges, full fused RDM, and RSA coefficients at q=100 over 1080 searchlights execute without materializing the packed geometry or any dense pair-query matrix; fused beats materialize-then-project 4x; independent raw-beta oracle 4.4e-16; route identity stable; memory pool under 512MiB against ~196MiB dense query avoided. Note: the gate deliberately ran only after Phase 2 made query-first true — the pre-fix measurement showed fused 3.9x SLOWER.
